svg.text: One mail becomes one draft, in nine stages
gate
Pure SQL. A mail that will never be drafted costs nothing at all.
classify
One of seven intents plus a language code, at temperature zero.
Anything unusable refuses; no draft is written.
condense
The mail into a short German search query.
few_shot + gather
This firm's own past replies, retrieval, and the thread tail.
Two different strings go to the two arms, see below.
fit
Drop to the budget, in one fixed order.
assemble
Deterministic. The German prompt text lives in files, one per prompt;
which lines a prompt gets, and in what order, stays in code.
generate
The one call to the drafting model. Capped at 800 output tokens.
assess
Trace every figure, score it, hold it if untraceable. Mechanical,
computed from the prompt, never asked of a model.
persist
A draft at PENDING or HELD, and one source row per citation.
When it does not fit, the order is fixed
1 · every few-shot example, all at once
2 · the oldest thread-tail messages, one at a time, never below one
3 · the lowest-ranked retrieved sources, from the bottom up
The order encodes one rule: correctness outranks voice. A draft that sounds slightly generic is
edited in thirty seconds. A draft that sounds exactly right and quotes a price from nowhere is the
failure this product cannot have.
